major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it close to on cooldown at 2 or fewer Holy Power, on an ally when you want healing and on an enemy when you want damage.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 375576 is the cast id, seen in 5/5 sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown whenever the group needs a healing boost, and spend the two instant Hand of Divinity Holy Lights inside the 20 seconds you have for them.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 31884 is the cast and self-aura id in 5/5 parses; 384376 is the unobserved talent node. Duration is 20s base and 30s with Sanctified Wrath.

major_cooldowns.name: Aura Mastery
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hold it until the raid is already injured, and cast Beacon of Virtue first so the Ringing of the Heavens Divine Toll transfers through your Beacons.

major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Crusader
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it when the group needs steady healing, then fill the window with Hammer of Wrath and Crusader Strike.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 216331 is castable per its tooltip but was not pressed in the sampled parses, which all played Avenging Wrath instead.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Prism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it close to on cooldown at 2 or fewer Holy Power, on an enemy for the most healing and on an ally only when that player needs it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 114165 is castable per its tooltip but was not pressed in the sampled parses, which all played Divine Toll instead.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Bulwark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown at 2 or fewer Holy Power on a squishy ally, or on yourself so Solidarity puts the second one on a tank.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 432459 is the cast id per its tooltip; the other Holy Bulwark ids are the wielded auras. Lightsmith build, not observed in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Sacred Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on yourself on cooldown at 2 or fewer Holy Power, and overwrite an Armament that is about to fade to force the Laying Down Arms Infusion of Light.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 432472 is the cast id per its tooltip; the other Sacred Weapon ids are the wielded auras. Lightsmith build, not observed in the sampled parses.

rule.description: Devotion Aura up for the whole pull
rule.action: Switch to Devotion Aura before the pull and leave it on, since it is the only aura worth running in raid.

rule.description: Spend Infusion of Light before it expires
rule.action: Fire the empowered Flash of Light at anyone hurt as soon as the proc lands, and Judgment when nobody needs the heal.

rule.description: Holy Shock never on capped Holy Power
rule.action: Cast Eternal Flame, Light of Dawn, or Shield of the Righteous first so the Holy Power it generates lands.

rule.description: Divine Toll sent at low Holy Power
rule.action: Dump Holy Power into a spender before you send it, because it hands you Holy Power from every target it hits.

rule.description: Divine Purpose procs spent on the next spender
rule.action: Use the free spender straight away, ahead of any Holy Power you have banked.

rule.description: Aura Mastery paired with Beacon of Virtue
rule.action: Put Beacon of Virtue out first in raid so Aura Mastery and its Divine Toll transfer through the extra Beacons.
